finish.title: Finish the clip
finish.smooth.title: Smooth the motion (double the frames)
finish.smooth.desc: Fills in between the frames so the motion is smoother. The length stays the same; the frame count and the frame rate double.
finish.enlarge.title: Enlarge (twice as wide and tall)
finish.enlarge.desc: Makes every frame larger with an upscale model. Takes more time and memory.
finish.noUpscaler: There is no upscale model. Add one from the Models screen.
finish.needsPack: Filling in frames needs the extension {pack}.
finish.note: The original stays as it is; the finished clip is added next to it.
finish.queued: Queued. The finished clip appears in the list
